property_summary: For a user who first calls buyDrugs(1 ether) and then sellDrugs(), the reference contract returns the correct ETH amount from calculateTrade while the buggy version returns a different value due to swapped subtraction operands in calculateTrade.
change_summary: Swap the subtraction operands in the very last division inside calculateTrade: replace SafeMath.sub(SafeMath.mul(PSN,rs),SafeMath.mul(PSNH,rt)) with SafeMath.sub(SafeMath.mul(PSNH,rt),SafeMath.mul(PSN,rs)).
